config.normalizer: max(abs(refined total candidate force), prior fine Newtonian force)
config.other_checks: Keep every unaffected parent control, including map, boundary and reflection checks. Recheck reflection and physical branch on refined variants.
config.registration: Parent galaxy outcomes already exposed; new high-resolution fields not yet computed. Numerical repair only, no new confirmation claim.
config.role: Numerical follow-up; no source or response selection and no tolerance relaxation
config.scalar_handling: Keep the previously admitted fine scalar field; conservatively add its fine-minus-coarse discrepancy to lambda squared times the new-minus-old fine auxiliary discrepancy. Both approximate the same exact continuous density, without changing source parameters.
config.stronger_coupling: lambda=10 remains unresolved under the original map and resolution gates; this run cannot score or promote it.
config.why_these_variants: These contain every resolution failure for p=2, lambda=6. Selection uses numerical discrepancies, not velocity residuals.
